input.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment rights for Client, reasonableness standard on Client consent, and confirm no Vendor exit on Client change of control.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added the customary affiliate and successor (merger/acquisition/sale of assets) carve-out so our internal reorganizations and M&A are not held up by consent, and made TrueLink's assignment subject to our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to a competitor. We also confirmed that a change of control of Client is not an assignment and gives TrueLink no termination or re-pricing right; if helpful, we can instead accept a mutual right to assign to successors on written notice.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Client may assign or transfer this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior approval of TrueLink, to an affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or equity. TrueLink shall not assign or transfer any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written approval of Client, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Client. Any other assignment by Client shall require the prior written approval of TrueLink, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld. No change of control of Client shall constitute an assignment or give TrueLink any right to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement.
